integration_required: Change existing R416 from100k to10k/1% in POWER_DOMAINS and generator/BOM; AUDIO sheet references it without assigning value.
Retain GPIO4 AUDIO_EN driving both TPS22918 switches and U805; GPIO6 AMP_SHUTDOWN; BCLK12/WS7/MIC_DATA11/SPEAKER_DATA43.

Flags assert MIC_3V3/AMP_SYS powered only with normal R411/R414 installed. They do not model a supply-fault or external-injection state.

audio_en_default_low.basis: TI TPS22918: each ON≤0.1uA, VILmax0.5V; TI1G14: II≤5uA and power-off Ioff≤10uA. Use larger10uA conservatively.
audio_en_default_low.limitation: Does not invent a MCU leakage value. Parent must include actual MCU/reset/PCB contribution and measure default low during ramp/brownout. Additional39.3uA is available before0.5V limit at10.1k.

hardware_operation.mcu_to_audio: U801 Nexperia74LVC125APW poweredMIC_3V3 buffers BCLK,WS,DIN,SD_MODE command. U805 TI1G14 on same rail actively raises all four OE when AUDIO_EN low; four physical OE pins explicitly junctioned and all found on actual AUDIO_OE_N net.
hardware_operation.return: U804 TI1G125 on3V3_AON buffers MIC_SD_RAW intoMCU; Ioff applies when AON0 but MIC residual voltage exists. R813100k at raw SD follows PUI recommendation. AON buffer supply current remains in deep-sleep budget.
hardware_operation.amp: MAX98357AETE+T poweredAMP_SYS. GAIN_SLOT=VDD gives6dB; SD_MODE via2k/1% plus100k external down selectsLEFT atnominal3.3V. R806 limits current whenIO exceedsVDD; it is not complete isolation.8ohm speaker and0R/EMI output parts are candidates.
poweroff_limits: U801/U805 Ioff limits finite leakage atVCC=0; no assertion of zero leakage or guaranteed logic through intermediate undervoltage.
AUDIO_EN hardware disable acts whileMIC rail is valid. DifferentMIC/AMP discharge rates require oscilloscope/current verification.
Do not infer MAX input backfeed behavior solely from absolute maximum values.
Mute and stop before opening R411/R414 measurement links. Keep rails valid during active clocks; do not externally inject into a disconnected rail without reviewingQOD and signal paths.

sampling_contract.reason: Conservative PUI normal-mode2.048–4.096MHz intersects MAX supported rates at64fs.32k sits exactly onlower bound; tolerance margin not guaranteed.44.1k/48k remain test candidates.
sampling_contract.data: MIC LEFT channel;24-bit words with18-bit precision plus6zeroLSBs. Software mixes/resamples playback intoLEFT; no hardware stereo average.
sampling_contract.startup: AUDIO_EN low, AMP_SHUTDOWN low, MCU clock/data low; enable both rails; wait valid rails; establish48k/64fs clocks and zero playback; discardMICstartupframes withmeasuredmargin; unmute last. PUI20ms is datasheet startup reference, not measured first valid frame guarantee.
sampling_contract.shutdown: Mute while clocks run, allow required amp turn-off, then stop BCLK without allowing runningBCLK with absentLRCLK; explicitly driveoutputs low, thenAUDIO_ENlow. Deleting I2S driver is not hardware isolation.
sampling_contract.legacy: Current16k firmware profile incompatible with selected PUI normal mode. Existing firmware deliberately unchanged.

cost_and_power_boundaries.price: No supplier quote or total-CNY claim. Need authorized channel stock/pricing for exact vendors plus PUI candidate before BOM freeze. Extra3logicIC and3decouplers trade area/cost for explicit partial-powerdown behavior; no added rail or GPIO.
cost_and_power_boundaries.logic_static: At stable valid levels, U801ICC≤10uA(-40..85C),≤40uA(-40..125C); U804/U805ICC≤10uA each. U804 is AON. Inputmidlevels may add supplycurrent; these values are not a wholeboard sleep result.
cost_and_power_boundaries.finite_leakage: U801Ioff±10uA to85C/±20uA to125C per specifiedIOcondition; U804/U805Ioff±10uA. Realrail leakage also includesTPS22918, PCB and peripherals. Do not sum a zero-leakage claim.
cost_and_power_boundaries.active_estimates: R41610k draws~330uA at3.3V. Each100k pull-down draws33uA whenhigh; BCLK/WS average~16.5uA at50%duty. Otherdata,SD_MODEinternalpull, Cpd andoutputcapacitance adddynamiccurrent. Values are nominal calculations, not measured.
cost_and_power_boundaries.mic_and_amp: PUI normal-mode current listed820–1000uA. MAX quiescent at3.7V/25C/no-speaker-load2.4mAtyp,2.85mAmax, plus speakerpower. SharedAUDIO_EN means playback keepsMICpowered; this revision does not independentlydisableMIC during playback.
